reading.body:
The identity and data-center function of this facility in Spain remain unconfirmed due to research limitations.

OpenStreetMap tags this location as a data center, but the name "The Weaver" carries no standard signal of IT infrastructure, hosting, or data operations. The name more commonly associates with textiles, craft, or hospitality businesses. This mismatch raises the possibility of a mistagged record, as seen elsewhere in the dataset, but the determination could not be verified when available search tools were exhausted.

The record sits 1.9 miles from Alicante-Elche Airport. Without operator information, website data, or confirmation of power capacity, nothing can be stated about its role in AI infrastructure or the broader Spanish data-center ecosystem. The facility publishes here as unconfirmed rather than guessed, which is the honest treatment the incomplete evidence allows.

This entry demonstrates a broader data problem: OSM infrastructure tags require on-ground verification that remote research cannot always complete. Facilities tagged as data centers without corroborating business registration or nameplate data remain ambiguous until confirmed by other means.
